ObjectStates.Nickname: SET_ITS18 Area Of Interest — Cargo Crossroads — REVISED
ObjectStates.Description:
Area Of Interest / Cargo Crossroads
48 × 48 inches; 300 points.
Terrain fitted to objective footprints and walking routes.
Players place the three Areas of Interest before deployment; do not pre-fix their locations.
Official mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/41bebca7-aed2-49b5-bc7d-c57e91476539
Geometry revision: TTS engine and visual review still required.

Deployment: take this bag into the normal Infinity mod and drop it onto its map deployment spot.
